examples.description: Find an invoice by its number

description: Finds invoices whose text fields (invoice number, notes, payment terms) contain every word of q. Rows carry the same worked-out money and state as invoice_read: total_cents, remaining_cents, state, is_overdue (integer CENTS), and payer_confirmations_pending. Refuses an empty q with VALIDATION_ERROR: send the invoice number, such as INV-2026-0001, or a word from its notes.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.

q.description: Search text (substring match over the entity's text properties; %/_ are literal).

name: invoice_search
